description: Read the state of an order the person already placed, from its order id and tracking token (both given to the person after ordering). Use it only for an existing order; it cannot find an order without its token. It never returns the document or a download link: it returns the funciara.com tracking page, where the person downloads the document.

orderId.description: The order id or order number the person received.

trackingToken.description: The tracking token the person received with the order.

name: get_order_status

estateIdentifier.description: The property number the order is for; null when the order has none to give.

trackingPageUrl.description: The funciara.com page of this order. The person opens it to see the order and download the document; give it to them instead of any file link. Null for the sandbox sample orders.

title: Get order status
